verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a built-in memory system that lets models remember facts, preferences, and context across conversations. Users can manage these memories under Settings > Personalization > Memory, so durable cross-session memory exists. The evidence explicitly shows only manual creation of memories, so it is unclear whether the assistant writes memories on its own. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the assistant automatically writes new memories, documentation of automatic recall behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the assistant remembers me across sessions — durable long-term memory it can write to and recall from automatically

citations.quote: Open WebUI includes a sophisticated memory system that allows models to remember facts, preferences, and context across different conversations.
The AI remembers facts about you across conversations
Users can manually add, edit, or delete memories by navigating to: Settings > Personalization > Memory
